title: Austin Budget & Zoning Actions
summary:
*   **City Budget Finalized:** The Council gave final approval to Austin's budget for the 1965-1966 fiscal year.
*   **Funding Allocations:** Official appropriations were made, distributing funds across all city departments, projects, and accounts.
*   **Zoning Decisions:** Actions were taken on a series of zoning ordinances that had been previously authorized.
transcript:
853
_ CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 13th day of
September, 1965, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at
10:00 A.M. for the purpose of passing the Ordinance Adopting and Approving the Budget for
1965-1966, and making appropriations for each Department, Project and Account, through its
second and final readings; and for action on zoning ordinances authorized September 9,
1965.
s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
ATTEST:
s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
s/ Lester E. Palmer
Mayor
City of Austin, Texas
CONSENT TO MEETING
We, the undersigned members of the City Council, hereby accept service of the foregoing
notice, waiving any and all irregularities in such service and such notice, and consent
and agree that said City Council shall meet at the time and place therein named, and for
the purpose therein stated. s/ Louis F. Shanks
s/ Travis LaRue
s/ Emma Long
s/ Ben White
